title: Brief special meeting authorizes closed training session
subtitle: Short procedural meeting with no delegations, disclosures of interest or mayoral updates.
overview: Council held a short special meeting on the morning of March 3, 2025. It was chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic, opened with a Land Acknowledgement and ran for only a few minutes. No one declared a pecuniary interest, and the mayor had no updates to share.

The only business was authorizing an in-camera meeting right after the special meeting. Council approved it {{vote:m1}}. The closed session was for an education and training session, which the Municipal Act, 2001 allows to be held in private.

For residents, there were no decisions on services, budgets, planning or bylaws at this meeting. The closed session was described only as education and training, and the minutes report no decisions from it. Councillor P. Singh joined the meeting as the in-camera authorization was taken up. The meeting then adjourned.

decisions.detail: Council authorized a closed meeting immediately after the special meeting to hold an education and training session under section 239 (3.1) of the Municipal Act, 2001.
